params.explicit_formula: psi_K(x) = x - log(2 pi) - (1/2) log(1 - x^-2) - 2 sqrt(x) sum_{k<=K} [(1/2) cos(gamma_k log x) + gamma_k sin(gamma_k log x)] / (1/4 + gamma_k^2)
params.psi_exact_definition: psi(x) = sum_{p^k <= x} log p, i.e. sum_{n <= x} Lambda(n) with Lambda(p^k) = log p placed at n = p^k and prefix-summed in ascending n; x inclusive
params.pi_definition: pi(x) = number of primes <= x, EXACT integer prefix sum of the same sieve
params.k_needed_definition: K_needed(x, target) = the SMALLEST K in the swept kvals set whose error is <= the target value; null when no swept K meets it
params.compressive_definition: COMPRESSIVE at x when K_needed is not null AND K_needed <= pi(x); EXPANSIVE when K_needed is null OR K_needed > pi(x). A null K_needed counts as EXPANSIVE because no swept K buys the target at that x; the null count is reported separately
params.precision: EXACT integer pi from the sieve; float64 psi_exact as a prefix sum of log p in ascending n; float64 cumulative explicit-formula sum. Gammas carry 12 decimals, so the phase gamma*log(x) carries ~1e-8 rad of input error at x = 1e4 and ~1e-10 rad of float64 argument-reduction error

constants.band_rule: COMPRESSES: K_needed <= pi(x) at EVERY x on the grid; INVERTS: K_needed > pi(x) for all x beyond some crossover point and that crossover lies strictly inside the grid (crossover_x not null, at least one compressive point below it, at least one expansive point above it); NEITHER otherwise. Precedence COMPRESSES > INVERTS > NEITHER
constants.truncation_scale_note: the truncation error is of order x log(x)/T with T the height of the last zero used, so pinning psi to +/- 1 needs T of order x log x, i.e. about x log(x)^2/(2 pi) zeros by Riemann-von Mangoldt, against x/log x primes below x
constants.o10_note: O10 is a deliberate gap in the series and is not filled by this script

gate_b.statement: psi_exact(10) equals the independently computed von Mangoldt sum over prime powers <= 10 (Lambda at 2,3,4,5,7,8,9)
